content.short: Ooki is an Ethereum-based decentralized exchange.
content.description: Ooki is a decentralized trading platform built on the Ethereum blockchain, with data services extended through Chainlink. Users can withdraw anytime and earn immediately after lending their assets. Beyond trading, Ooki includes a DAO and a University, reflecting its community governance and educational initiatives. The platform features minimal liquidation fees and supports a wide range of trading positions, providing flexibility for diverse strategies.
